source_note: Positions are from the September 2019 YWA SRRC register redigitized in QGIS (docs/qgis/Swan River Marks/), in GDA94 geographic coordinates. GDA94 differs from present-epoch WGS84 by about 1.8 m in this part of Australia, which is below GPS scatter and applies to every mark alike, so it is recorded rather than corrected. Names, numbers, rounding, owner and structure are the register's own, carried in the layer's attributes. Number is display only and is NOT unique: 37, 38, 39, 45 and 52 are each used by more than one mark. Always key on id.
